symptom: A Zeros workspace folder whose .git link was lost let engine Git discover the repository enclosing the managed workspaces root, so status, stage, commit or push acted on that unrelated repository.
rule: Engine Git spawns carry GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES for every managed workspace root (or its nearest listable ancestor), prepended to any inherited list; only archive/delete identity checks are not enough. See playbooks/bug-fix.md.
